Go embed filesystem (//go:embed directive); /bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go

The compiled React frontend is served using Go's **embed filesystem** mechanism. The `frontend.go` file uses the `//go:embed dist/*` directive (line 20) to embed the compiled frontend build artifacts (from the `dist/` directory) directly into the compiled binary at build time. The `FrontendService.Serve()` method (line 41) registers an Echo middleware that serves these static files and uses a SPA fallback middleware (line 59) to serve `index.html` for client-side routes. The service is wired to the main Echo server in `/bench/repo/server/server.go`.
